subject: One-off incentive approval: temporary merit + equity deferral for P. Ghosh
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for one-off incentive approval — P. Ghosh

Hi Laura,

Quick request for an exception approval. Paul Ghosh (L2 Eng) is a high-impact IC on the Payments team — core contributor to the recent throughput improvements that kept the Q3 launch on schedule. He just had a manager-calibrated performance rating of "Exceeds" for the mid-year review and is at ~88% of midpoint comp.

We would like to grant a one-off cash incentive (one-time merit) of $6,000 and defer a small equity refresh (target 1,000 RSUs) to the next refresh cycle (to keep grant cadence consistent with laddering rules). The combined one-off value is ~<$50k (equity not vested until next refresh).

Rationale attached: comp_rationale_ghosh_20261001.pdf and salary_history_ghosh_20261001.csv.

Ask: please confirm if you can approve the one-off cash incentive and the deferral approach, or if you want this routed to exec signoff. Also confirm whether payroll needs a special code for one-off payments under "temporary_incentive".

Thanks — I can be available for a quick call if useful.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: comp_rationale_ghosh_20261001.pdf (application/pdf), salary_history_ghosh_20261001.csv (text/csv)

My take: supportive given impact and calibration, and the equity deferral keeps us within cadence policy. Asking for your quick green light for payroll and sign-off. If you prefer, we can route through Finance for >$50k thresholds — this is under that, but want to be explicit.

If you need more context, Marissa's rationale is attached.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for one-off incentive approval — quick questions

Thanks for the context. A few quick questions before I approve: 

1) Confirmation of calibration: was the rating endorsed in manager calibration (yes/no) and what percentile within the peer cohort?
2) Comp impact: cash only $6k now; equity 1,000 RSUs deferred — need an estimated grant-date value for the RSUs for reporting.
3) Budget source: which org budget will absorb this (team discretionary vs central retention pool)? Please name the GL code.
4) Precedent: any similar approvals in the past 12 months in Eng? If so, provide examples.

If all of the above are reasonable, I can sign off and will add an approval doc. For approvals >$50k we route to Finance + Legal; this is under that threshold but we still need payroll to confirm processing path.

Please reply with the items above and attach any calibration notes.

Rishi
VP, People & Talent
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Ghosh <paul.ghosh@stearns-hr.com>, payroll <payroll@thirdparty-payments.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 16:50:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: One-off incentive + equity deferral for P. Ghosh

Folks — thanks for the quick turnaround.

Answers inline to Rishi's questions and next steps: 

1) Calibration: Yes — Marissa confirmed manager calibration and peer endorsement in the 9/28 calibration session. Paul sits in the top quartile of his peer cohort for impact. (see attached calibration excerpt).

2) Comp impact: Cash $6,000 (one-time). Equity: 1,000 RSUs to be issued at the next scheduled refresh (expected grant date 2027-01-10). Estimated grant-date value (conservative): $18,000. Combined nominal value ~24k (below $50k threshold).

3) Budget: Team discretionary budget (GL 410-ENG-PAY-TRM). Marissa confirms available headroom this quarter.

4) Precedent: Two narrow one-off cash incentives were approved in the last 12 months (S. Patel — $4k, C. Lin — $5k). Both were documented and routed through Payroll.

Decision: Approved. Rishi — please sign the attached approval_signoff_rishi_20261003.docx and I will initiate DocuSign for records. Payroll, please process the $6,000 under code "temporary_incentive" to be paid on next payroll run (10/15/2026). Paul (external) — looped for visibility on timing and equity deferral mechanics.

DocuSign link (will be finalized): https://docusign.example.com/agreements/DS-XYZ123
Jira ticket for payroll flow: https://jira.redwood.internal/HR-4567

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference
